codivew.description: Review Git changes with Codivew and a local Ollama model.
config.language: Language used by the Codivew interface, review feedback, and reports.
config.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language.
config.ollamaUrl: Ollama server URL used for code reviews.
config.model: Ollama model used for code reviews.
config.baseBranch: Default base branch for branch reviews.
config.projectContext: Project context included in every review prompt.
config.maxDiffChars: Maximum filtered Diff size in characters for one review.
